_readme: Generated by make_fixtures.py from real captures taken 2026-09-24. Each entry is one real Snapchat profile page cut down to the __NEXT_DATA__ fields the parser reads and its ProfilePage JSON-LD. Other people's comments, the translation table and the per-visit config ids are absent rather than redacted. Run `python3 make_fixtures.py --verify` to re-check that a trimmed fixture parses identically to its untrimmed original in every mode.
